name: @activepieces/piece-alai
description: AI-powered presentation generation API. Create, export, and manage professional presentations from text.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to get your Alai API Key:

1. Go to [**https://getalai.com/api**](https://getalai.com/api) and sign up or log in.
2. Navigate to the **API Keys** section.
3. Click **Create API Key** and give it a name (e.g., "Activepieces").
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

generatePresentation.name: generatePresentation
generatePresentation.description: Create a new AI-generated presentation from text.

inputText.description: The text content to generate a presentation from.

additionalInstructions.description: Extra instructions for how the presentation should be generated.

exportFormats.description: Formats to export the presentation in after generation.

title.description: A title for the presentation. If not provided, one will be generated.

themeId.description: The ID of the presentation theme to use. If not provided, a default theme will be applied.

tone.description: The tone of voice for the presentation content.

contentMode.description: How the input text should be handled.

amountMode.description: The amount of text to include per slide.

includeAiImages.description: Whether to include AI-generated images in the presentation.

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the presentation generation to complete before returning.

maxWaitTime.description: Maximum time to wait for completion (default 300 seconds / 5 minutes).

aiMetadata.description: Generate a brand-new presentation from input text via the Alai AI API, with optional controls for tone, slide count, text density, theme, and AI images. Use this to turn raw text into slides. By default it returns immediately with a generation_id (poll Get Generation for status); set Wait for Completion to block until the deck finishes (up to Max Wait Time). Not idempotent: each call starts a new generation.

getGeneration.name: getGeneration
getGeneration.description: Fetch the status and result of a generation job.

generationId.description: The ID of the generation job (from the "Generate Presentation" action).

aiMetadata.description: Look up the current status and result of an Alai generation job by its generation_id (returned by Generate Presentation or Export Presentation). Use this to poll for completion or retrieve the finished output and export links. Read-only and idempotent. Requires a valid generation_id.

exportPresentation.name: exportPresentation
exportPresentation.description: Export a presentation in the specified formats.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to export.

exportFormats.description: Formats to export the presentation in.

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the presentation generation to complete before returning.

maxWaitTime.description: Maximum time to wait for completion (default 300 seconds / 5 minutes).

aiMetadata.description: Export an existing Alai presentation into one or more formats (link, PDF, and/or PPTX) by its presentation ID. Use this to render a deck for download or sharing. By default it returns immediately with a generation_id (poll Get Generation for status); set Wait for Completion to block until the export finishes (up to Max Wait Time). Not idempotent: each call kicks off a new export job. Requires the presentation ID and at least one export format.

addSlide.name: addSlide
addSlide.description: Add a new slide to an existing presentation.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to get your Alai API Key:

1. Go to [**https://getalai.com/api**](https://getalai.com/api) and sign up or log in.
2. Navigate to the **API Keys** section.
3. Click **Create API Key** and give it a name (e.g., "Activepieces").
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

slide_context.description: The content or topic for the slide to be generated.

additionalInstructions.description: Extra instructions for how the slide should be generated.

slide_order.description: The position to insert the new slide (e.g., "0" for the first slide, "end" to add at the end).

includeAiImages.description: Whether to include AI-generated images in the slide.

aiMetadata.description: Generate and insert a new AI-authored slide into an existing Alai presentation, given the presentation ID and the slide content/topic; optional slide order controls where it lands (a numeric index, or "end" to append). Use this to extend a deck after it has been generated. Not idempotent: each call appends another slide.

deletePresentation.name: deletePresentation
deletePresentation.description: Delete a presentation by its ID.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete an Alai presentation by its ID. Use this to remove a deck the user no longer needs. Destructive but idempotent: once deleted, repeating the call with the same ID leaves the same end state. Requires the presentation ID.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
